title: Noctalia GIF Player
missing_engine: The Rust gif-player executable is unavailable. Install the engine or set its full path.
empty: No matching GIFs. Add GIFs to the configured collection directory.
no_active: No active GIFs. Start one from Collection.
restore: Restore the last layout at startup
click_through: Locked GIFs pass through all pointer input. Overlays never take keyboard focus. Unlock to drag; scroll to resize.
fullscreen_note: Overlay is the highest normal layer-shell layer. Visibility over fullscreen windows depends on the compositor. Session-lock surfaces always take priority.
